{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for QA outliers: revenue = 999999.99
df_qa = df_completed[df_completed['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(df_qa)}')

# Filter out QA orders
df_final = df_completed[df_completed['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA)
mean_revenue = df_final['revenue_clean'].mean()
print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA): {mean_revenue}')"}
